title: The Prophetic Manhaj in Practical Tarbiyah

text_simplified: The text discusses the Prophetic manhaj in tarbiyah, which considers human capacities and does not burden a person beyond their ability. It explains that this manhaj is practical, dealing with the human being in all their aspects (body, mind, soul) as well as their emotions and dreams. It also highlights that the Prophet ﷺ used to nurture his companions upon balance and avoidance of extremism in worship.
